purpose: The anti-overfit variation for BUG-SHADOW-NAME. Fixture 01 proves ONE open shadow root resolves its own labels; this proves the rule is the general one - names resolve against the node's own root at any depth - and that the fix scopes correctly rather than widening the search to the whole document.
targeted_defect: BUG-SHADOW-NAME (variation): a fix that resolved shadow names by searching the TOP-LEVEL document would make fixture 01 pass while naming input#account.inner 'Outer Account Number' - a wrong but plausible name that binds to the wrong field at replay instead of failing loudly. This fixture fails that fix.

expect_controls.why: The light-DOM control keeps its own label. The shadow root must not capture it.
THE decisive assertion. Same id as the outer control; a document-scoped lookup names this 'Outer Account Number'.
Two labels for one control inside a shadow root - the first in document order wins, as it does in the light DOM.
TWO shadow boundaries deep. Resolution must follow the node's own root at any nesting depth.
aria-labelledby resolved two boundaries deep - the id-reference rung uses the same root as label[for], and the CAP-03 accessible-text fix must survive shadow scoping.
